content: this legal text summarizes the progress of a divorce case that took place in liege on october 7th 2015 the judge made a decision regarding the division of matrimonial property the exwife was allocated the former matrimonial residence based on an expert valuation the sale prices of jointly owned vehicles were adjusted to reflect their market values the exhusbands professional clientele as a physiotherapist was considered personal property and subject to division including outstanding fees the court also addressed the valuation of the exhusbands professional equipment and confirmed the division of assets based on the evidence provided the costs of the appeal will be paid by the estate the decision was based on specific articles of the old civil code the document discusses the division of property including the valuation and sale of immovable property and motor vehicles it also addresses the valuation of the physiotherapists clientele and the distribution of furniture and equipment the court makes rulings on each aspect of the case upholding some decisions and making adjustments to others the document concludes by stating that the appeals and crossappeals have been received and that the case will be referred back to the notary for further action
